actions.description: Analyze the observed run: execution journal of the change (and its sub-agents), OpenTelemetry spans of its trace; per-action statistics and findings.
actions.name: analyze_run

actions.description: Create the new draft version of the methodology with the accepted proposals
actions.name: draft_methodology

actions.description: Rules: specialize a regular-output LLM action with a script, use a faster model for a costly LLM action, raise the cost of a looping action, remove a disabled action from an agent, request an MCP tool for a slow point.
actions.name: propose_by_rules

actions.description: Propose improvements to the methodology from the findings (change impacts on its elements)
actions.name: propose_improvements

actions.description: LLM analysis of the cost report (enable with the llm_review variable)
actions.name: propose_with_llm

actions.description: Review of improvement proposals by a methodologist
actions.instructions: Accept or reject each improvement (a comment is required). Accepted improvements will be integrated into a new draft version of the methodology, to be published from the editor.
actions.name: review_improvements

agents.description: Observes completed runs and proposes to improve their methodology
agents.name: observer
